calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

## Only the owner can answer

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Plain` in scope for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (a public org repository) but not registered on bestpractices.dev.

## Findings

- [ ] not registered on bestpractices.dev

## Register

Registration is the maintainer's, on the site (it has no registration API):

1. Logged in, add the project at https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/new with https://github.com/swarm-routing/Plain.
2. Nothing else: the next weekly run finds the project by its URL, and this issue then carries the proposal link(s) to Save and asks for `bestpractices_project = "<id>"` in `.github/org-sync.toml`.

Not wanted for this repository? `bestpractices = false` under `[settings]` in `.github/org-sync.toml` takes it out of scope, and this issue closes at the next run.

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository ([run](https://github.com/swarm-routing/.github/actions/runs/123)).

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Plain` in scope for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (a public org repository) but not registered on bestpractices.dev ([run](https://github.com/swarm-routing/.github/actions/runs/123)).

## Findings

- [ ] not registered on bestpractices.dev

## Register

Registration is the maintainer's, on the site (it has no registration API):

1. Logged in, add the project at https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/new with https://github.com/swarm-routing/Plain.
2. Nothing else: the next weekly run finds the project by its URL, and this issue then carries the proposal link(s) to Save and asks for `bestpractices_project = "<id>"` in `.github/org-sync.toml`.

Not wanted for this repository? `bestpractices = false` under `[settings]` in `.github/org-sync.toml` takes it out of scope, and this issue closes at the next run.

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---

Proto.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

---

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

Clean.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

---

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Rel` in scope for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (a public org repository) but not registered on bestpractices.dev.

## Findings

- [ ] not registered on bestpractices.dev

## Register

Registration is the maintainer's, on the site (it has no registration API):

1. Logged in, add the project at https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/new with https://github.com/swarm-routing/Rel.
2. Nothing else: the next weekly run finds the project by its URL, and this issue then carries the proposal link(s) to Save and asks for `bestpractices_project = "<id>"` in `.github/org-sync.toml`.

Not wanted for this repository? `bestpractices = false` under `[settings]` in `.github/org-sync.toml` takes it out of scope, and this issue closes at the next run.

---
_Generated by the weekly `bestpractices` workflow (swarm-routing/.github)._

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 5 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained, test, warnings, static_analysis, dynamic_analysis
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&test_status=Met&test_justification=An%20automated%20test%20suite%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Ftree%2Fmain%2Fcore%2Ftest.&warnings_status=Met&warnings_justification=Compiler%20warnings%20on%20%28-Wall%20-Wextra%29%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCMakeLists.txt.&static_analysis_status=Met&static_analysis_justification=Static%20analysis%20on%20every%20change%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fworkflows%2Fcodeql.yml.&dynamic_analysis_status=Met&dynamic_analysis_justification=Dynamic%20analysis%20%28fuzzing%29%20in%20CI%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fworkflows%2Ffuzz.yml.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---

Proto.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". Owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site; no repository file shows them, so they are never proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`
- `enhancement_responses`
- `vulnerability_report_response`
- `know_secure_design`
- `know_common_errors`
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`
- `no_leaked_credentials`

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---

calls.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". The owner-only criteria the maintainer attested (`.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` in swarm-routing/.github) are included when the check finds nothing against them; the other owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Met&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site and not proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Five are attested by the maintainer in `.github/bestpractices-owner.toml` (swarm-routing/.github) and proposed above once the check finds nothing against them; the others are never proposed. Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `enhancement_responses`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `vulnerability_report_response`: not attested; answered on the site only
- `know_secure_design`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `know_common_errors`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)
- `no_leaked_credentials`: no maintainer attestation (.github/bestpractices-owner.toml in swarm-routing/.github)

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---

Proto.body:
## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `cmd/bestpractices`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] 1 answer(s) in .bestpractices.json not on the site yet: maintained
- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Save

**Open, review, Save.** Each link opens the project's form, logged in, with the answers from `.bestpractices.json` on main filled in; nothing changes until you press "Save (and continue)". Owner-only criteria are left out.

1. https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/42/passing/edit?contribution_status=Met&contribution_justification=The%20contribution%20process%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FCONTRIBUTING.md.&maintained_status=Met&maintained_justification=Last%20commit%20to%20main%202026-11-01%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fcommits%2Fmain.&build_status=Unmet&build_justification=Built%20with%20make%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fswarm-routing%2FProto%2Fblob%2Fmain%2FMakefile.

## Only the owner can answer

Still `?` on the site; no repository file shows them, so they are never proposed (swarm-routing/AntHocNet#790). Listed here, not counted as findings:

- `report_responses`
- `enhancement_responses`
- `vulnerability_report_response`
- `know_secure_design`
- `know_common_errors`
- `vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days`
- `vulnerabilities_critical_fixed`
- `no_leaked_credentials`

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API: the bot never logs in or saves. `.bestpractices.json` is regenerated from the repository by org-bot (task `bestpractices`), and a fix belongs in the repository first; then the link above carries it.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry matches.

---
_Generated by the weekly `bestpractices` workflow (swarm-routing/.github)._
